notes.title: PATCH 1.0.5 - The External Quests update
notes.notes:
PATCH 1.0.5 - The External Quests update
[previewyoutube="q7hlEQS4ls0;full"][/previewyoutube]
In this update, I begin to introduce The External Quests. External Quests are basically mini-games that can be played more than once, either for the fun of it or to complete the challenges given. Currently there are 4 External Quests, and there will be more hopefully with each coming expansion.

Other from the External Quests there are some changes that I will discuss in this post.
The External Quests
As I said, External Quests are mini-games that can be played more than once unlike a normal quest.
The Arena:
The Arena is a round-based mini-game that gets harder every round. You will be placed in an 'Arena' with all your items (though be ready to equip them fast) as you have 5 seconds break between each round.

The Arena has 5 rewards for finishing round 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. the reward increases each time.

It also has '2' new achievements for finishing round 5 and 30. Rounds are endless and therefore there is a high record counter for those who just want to keep on grinding.

The Arena is also very helpful if the player wants to grind materials, xp, and kill counts for challenges. 
A Creature's Dream:
A Creature's Dream is a fun mini-game where you enter the mind of a sleeping Night beast only to discover his dream is chasing the main character (Viro) around.

In this mini-game you will be given 2 minutes to kill all 15 Viros in the game. If you fail, you gotta go again. In the quest itself there is small progress where if you kill 1 Viro, you unlock speed boost. And if you kill 3 Viros, you unlock X-ray vision. Then after that each kill decreases the cooldown of abilites by 1 second (minimum 1 second).

This quest offers '1' new achievement ;)
Sky Run:
Sky Run is a quick parkour map where you have to reach the portal before you are put into the red zone where you will be damaged till you die. (You wont be able to open the inventory in this quest)

Also in the run there are mysterious stones that you have to collect, for some reason ;]

'1' achievement.
The Desert's Trap:
The Desert's Trap is the hardest External Quest by far. Where you are put into a huge Maze, have to find your way to 3 runes, activating these runes, then find your way to the portal out, and all this while trying to avoid the Maze Fire Hunters.

Around the maze you will find mystery gifts where it will either give you a bad buff or a good buff (50/50 chance)

You will also find portals that teleport you randomly into another portal.

so its basically a gamble. (did i also mention you wont be able to open the inventory?)

This quest offers 1 real achievement.
Other ChangesMore Info UI:
In the "game info" menu, now there are more info added. Npc info, Materials info, and more info the enemies info.
Trader change:
now you will be able to trade with Astr at a much higher rate using the multiplication option.
Prodigy Difficulty Change:
I realized that the Prodigy Difficulty was more impossible than prodigy. So I decreased the hp of every boss in this difficulty to 500.

there are other small changes that not worth mentioning here.



Thank you for playing my game..

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.4 - A World Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0rXTxWmBjG8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]For the past couple weeks I have been focused on how to make the world more engaging for the player. As to make it more visually appealing, and making it unique. I had an idea to make the player feel like he is in a different place where ever he goes, as to make the areas feel different from each other.

World Update

Sentrum

First step in upgrading the world, by adding more things to it. And one of the biggest challenge was the early game, which the player didn't have much to do. And so more areas has been added around Sentrum as well as more hidden treasures and secrets. So that when the player first leaves Sentrum, he already has things to do and enemies to fight. Also starter materials has been added in Sentrum so the player can craft decent items from the start.

The Forest

The forest has been entirely improved, the landscape and visually has been changed. More collectables, and overall better experience. The Black Forest has been tweaked a little bit, but not as much as the forest.

The Arbo Woods and The Lonely Woods

A new road to The Lonely Woods has been made from the Arbo woods. The Lonely Woods also has been changed in terms of landscape. Though no more collectables were added to it. 

The Monkey Kingdom

The Monkey Kingdom is by far the most place with changes. Its first area has been entirely changed in terms of landscape. To add more details to it, lightning strikes were also added in the first area that damage both enemies and the player. 

You may also notice new monuments has been added around the world (three at the moment) These monuments are currently empty but it has something special for them coming in patch 1.0.5.

A New Prologue

A new area, new enemies, and a new boss has been added to the prologue. With new achievement for defeating the boss.

Other World Changes

Some other changes were mainly improvements and are not specific. So I will leave them for the player to discover.

Gameplay 

Another big change were the game play enhancements. Now the player and all the enemies in the game are faster. Also now all the enemies do not stop when they attack which adds to that challenge and fast-paced combat.

Other Changes

[olist]
 Quick Menu destroys inventory FIXED
 Damage Text for enemies now show true damage dealt
 abilities icons not vanishing FIXED
 player can no longer be able to save in a boss fight
 secret chests counter FIXED
 the 3 Million footsteps (Skywalker) Achievement has been removed
 UI Map improved and Updated
 Stuck Button Added
[/olist]

Thats it for now, but more to come!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494224/37efb71f81403144a7fca84b629cce9de87b8398.jpg

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.3!! biggest patch till now.
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ZDFBYCtWsgI;full][/previewyoutube]PATCH 1.0.3

this patch is the biggest patch till now. This patch improves the game in many ways, gameplay wise, player experience wise, content wise. I will be putting in details everything new in this patch.

Gameplay

New Quick Menu

The new Quick Menu is the biggest improvement on the combat/gameplay. It offers a whole new way of combat with dynamically change weapons and create countless combos with legendary weapons.

In this new Quick Menu you will have 5 slots. First 2 slots are for right handed equipment (Swords, large axes, staffs, etc.) The third slot is for left handed equipment (Shields) The last 2 slots are for potions. 
The player can then equip the weapons using the default keys (2,3,4,5,6) or keys the player chooses. 
If you equip a weapon and you already hold a weapon, it will be put in place of the weapon you took.
for exmp, you have a sword with your hand and an axe in slot 1. When you press the key, now the axe is in your hand and the sword is in slot 1.

The player doesn't need to press G anymore (unless he wants to) to put back the weapons in hand to equip another weapon.

if you already have a save ingame, drop the items and retake them from the inventory so that the quick menu options are updated to the items.

Enhanced Movement

A little improvement in gameplay is the enhanced movement. Where now the player and the horse accelerate at a much higher speed. And so now the momentum in combat is much smoother.

Player Experience

Player Experience is a big factor in Trek, where the player should have a smooth gameplay. 
I listened, and i acted. 

Compass

The biggest issue the players had, is that the navigation around the world is difficult. (Since there is no player marker on the map)
So i decided to add a compass (both on player HUD and Map) to help the player navigate through the world. 
Though note that the compass is still under experiment and might not be fully accurate and potentially be updated in the future.

As well three more bridges are added to sentrum

Horse

Some of the players were losing their horses a lot, and so now you can whistle for your horse. The horse will make a loud sound heard from a fair distance letting the player know where it is.

The player can now open the inventory and materials tab while being on the horse. As well open the quests and game info from the pause menu.

Quest Tracker

Some players where having an issue on what to do next, and so a Quest Tracker has been added to the game. The Quest Tracker tells the player what to do next and keeps track of progression.

The Quest tracker will be ON by default but it can be turned OFF by pressing N or by opening the quests menu.

The Quest Tracker will be showing quests in the order it is set in the quests menu. If there are no more quests to do, the Quest Tracker will turn off automatically.
You might see the Quest Tracker sometimes popup and go away (if there are no more quests) That's just the Tracker detecting if there is quests to do or if it is on or off.

New Content

Some players had an issue where they though that the map is "too empty" And not much to do between Quests.
And so some new stuff are added all over the world.
[olist]
 19 New Achievements
 Scrolls to collect
 Secret Chests and Mazes
 Secret Interactions
 Secret Boss
[/olist]

The Prodigy Difficulty

Introducing the new difficulty, with a series of achievements. The Prodigy Difficulty has its own 8 Achievements. In this difficulty everything is the same as the normal one, but you cannot craft any equipment except the pickaxe and tree chopper. (You will be able to craft potions)

Other Changes

[olist]
 Lighting Enhancement
 Show interactions UI
 Damage Indicator
 Ability Mechanic changes in Raio and Kahiko
 Show how many materials you have when crafting or in game info
 Indicators when about to hit an invisible wall
 New Tutorial, more open and free
 Materials in Sentrum
 Chest sound effect when collected
[/olist]

That is for now, but more to come.
and always Thank You For Playing My Game.

notes.title: Upcoming PATCH 1.0.3
notes.notes:
The reason the game did not get a patch for 2-3 weeks now is because I am working on a Big Patch
I have been taking a lot of feedback from the players and Patch 1.0.3 will include many stuff and many changes into the game. 

The highlighted changes of Patch 1.0.3:

Combat Rework

The Combat of the game is gonna be enhanced a lot. Dynamic Switch mechanic is the big change in the new Combat system. Improving that fast-paced combat of the game.

Player Experience


 I listened and many player's issue was navigation around the map. If you may not know, I decided not to include the player marker in the map as i take a different path into navigation where the players needs to know where he is according to the surroundings. So I decided in order to help the player navigate I included a compass in the upcoming patch.
 Small changes in player experience is actions were limited when mounting the horse (for exp, Opening inventory, checking quest status) And so all will be included.
 Some players had an issue with what quests to do and so a quest tracker will be included. The quest tracker will tell you what quest you have to do now. (The tracker will be on by default but it can be turned off my pressing a certain key on the keyboard (for exp, currently N) or turn it off in the quests menu. 
 An important one is that some players seem to lose and have hard time finding their horse. And so a mechanic is added where you will be able to whistle and the horse will make a sound, helping you find it.
 Other changes: Three more bridges to Sentrum, Indicators to tell when you will hit an invincible wall, adding full screen option, new tutorial.


Content


Although there is enough content for 10+ hours in the game, some players complained that the map is kinda empty where there isnt always something to do.
And so many things will be added:

 Buildings/Houses around the world some filled with Materials and Secrets.
 19 more Achievements, including collectibles, secret interactions, the first secret boss.
 The beginning of the hardest achievements called "The Prodigy" 8 of these achievements will be added. 


Other Changes


 An Ability Rework for both Kahiko and Raio.
 Kahiko, Uka, and Raio will be stun resistant. 
 Any bug that is currently in the game will probably be fixed.
 Other minor changes and additions. 


This is the Biggest Update till now. And more to come.
